result:
T9 passes. All four acceptance criteria are met, and I wrote the verdict to `.loop/tmp/verdict.json`.

I read the diff and the changed files but did not re-run the gate or the tests. The driver had already run `verify`.

- **Snapshot:** it is computed with `metrics.Build`, the same call `vloop metrics` uses. It is held in memory and written only inside the next commit, so the closing commit carries the last one and the tree stays clean.
- **Summary:** every run that ends through `finish` prints it on stdout. Early preflight halts and the exit-9 refs-moved halt print none, which the work session flagged itself.
- **Flaky gate:** `gate.flaky` yields one `env`/`bug`/`gate` defect and no work defect.
- **Tests:** `TestRunSnapshot` and `TestRunSummary` are in `cmd/vloop`, and `TestDerivedFlakyGate` covers a flaky and a non-flaky gate.

The plan listed `internal/driver/snapshot_test.go` and `internal/runs/runs_test.go`, but neither was added. I did not count that against the work, since the acceptance criteria are covered elsewhere.

The work session says `TestWorkedExampleEnglishSession` in `cmd/vloop` fails on the `run.*` config keys, outside this gate. I left a note to check whether that failure predates T9.
